from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,shutil
root=Path('/tmp/wbs100-dns-closure-20261019')
source=Path('apps/twilight-structure/twilight-burokrat/cli/src/policy/trusted-modules.ts');saved=source.read_bytes()
archive=Path('dist/twilight-burokrat-pack/twilight-burokrat-0.1.0.tgz');shutil.copyfile(archive,root/'twilight-burokrat-dns-dirty-green.tgz')
def run(label,command):
 invocation=subprocess.run(['python3',str(root/'guard.py'),str(root/label),*command]);receipt=json.loads((root/(label+'.receipt.json')).read_text())
 assert invocation.returncode==0 and receipt['stopReason'] is None,(label,receipt)
 return receipt
pack=['env','NX_DAEMON=false','NX_ISOLATE_PLUGINS=false','bunx','nx','run','twilight-burokrat:pack']
test=['bun','test','apps/twilight-structure/twilight-burokrat/cli/src/packaging/install.test.ts','--test-name-pattern','extracts supported vendor relationships and public declarations outside the checkout']
try:
 fault=saved.replace(b"  '@types/dns-packet',\n",b'');assert fault!=saved;source.write_bytes(fault)
 (root/'types-fault-source.json').write_text(json.dumps({'head':'0e444bcc4ba7e5d7e30b1c220d51e25dd7e5ffc5','dirty':True,'trustedModulesSha256':hashlib.sha256(fault).hexdigest(),'fault':'only @types/dns-packet removed from explicit roots'},indent=2)+'\n')
 assert run('pack-types-omitted',pack)['exitCode']==0
 descriptor=json.loads(Path('apps/twilight-structure/twilight-burokrat/cli/dist/toolkit/toolkit.json').read_text())
 assert 'dns-packet' in descriptor['trustedNodeModules'] and '@leichtgewicht/ip-codec' in descriptor['trustedNodeModules']
 assert '@types/dns-packet' not in descriptor['trustedNodeModules']
 (root/'types-fault-artifact.json').write_text(json.dumps({'archiveSha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'descriptor':descriptor},indent=2)+'\n')
 assert run('installed-types-omitted',test)['exitCode']==1
 log=(root/'installed-types-omitted.stderr').read_text()
 assert "dns-packet" in log and ('TypeScript compiler failed:' in log or 'TypeScript import unresolved:' in log),log
 assert 'toolkit runtime closure differs' not in log,log
finally:
 source.write_bytes(saved)
assert run('pack-restored',pack)['exitCode']==0
assert run('installed-restored',test)['exitCode']==0
(root/'types-fault-restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceRestored':source.read_bytes()==saved,'restoredSourceSha256':hashlib.sha256(saved).hexdigest(),'restoredArchiveSha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Authenticated runtime-only omission refused; restored package passed all installed controls')
